+# Field protocol — the 0.1.0 device sessions
+
+Everything the remaining 0.1.0 validation needs from a physical iPhone, in
+one place: FRO-392 (go/no-go battery report), FRO-393 (A/B experiments),
+FRO-394 (resilience drills), plus the S2 leftovers. Total: one indoor hour
+plus 3+ rides.
+
+## 0. Install (once per phone)
+
+1. Open `Rouleur.xcodeproj` in Xcode, select the **RouleurHarness** scheme,
+   destination = your iPhone, Run. (Signing team is configured; first run on
+   a new phone needs Settings → General → VPN & Device Management → trust.)
+2. Launch the harness, tap START once — grant **When-In-Use** location when
+   prompted — then STOP. The app is ready.
+3. Optional (S2 lab): tap LAB → "Request HealthKit authorization" → grant
+   all. Needed only for the workout-session drills.
+
+Data comes back via the **LOG** button (share sheet → AirDrop) — one CSV per
+run. Analyze on the Mac with:
+
+```sh
+python3 scripts/analyze-s1.py harness-*.csv
+```
+
+## 1. FRO-392 — battery/accuracy report rides (the go/no-go)
+
+**Protocol** (per the ticket):
+
+- ≥3 rides of 1–2 h, at least one in direct midday sun, phone bar-mounted,
+  max auto-brightness, screen on the whole ride (START and leave it).
+- Reference head unit (Garmin/Wahoo) recording side-by-side for
+  distance/speed/elevation comparison.
+- Two device generations if possible (13-class + 15/16-class).
+- Note ambient temp and any visible dimming; the CSV captures thermal state,
+  brightness, and battery timeline.
+
+**Thresholds**: pass ≤8 %/h screen-on · stretch ≤6 · kill/pivot >12.
+Distance ±2% vs reference; speed stable ±1 km/h at cruise; elevation ±10%.
+
+**Output**: per-ride table from `analyze-s1.py` + subjective sunlight-
+readability note → written report on FRO-392 with a go/no-go recommendation.
+
+## 2. FRO-393 — A/B arms (same route, ≥1 h per arm)
+
+Controls: fix brightness manually (note the value — it's logged), airplane
+mode ON for both arms, same route/day where possible. Toggle **exactly one**
+variable per segment — each toggle writes an event row the analyzer segments
+on, so a single long ride can carry multiple arms.
+
+1. **BLK vs WHT** at outdoor brightness — validates the OLED display-power
+   claim.
+2. **10 Hz vs 60 Hz** — the low-refresh win.
+3. **LIVE vs MGR** (liveUpdates vs legacy manager) — energy cost of the
+   modern path; no public measurement exists.
+
+`analyze-s1.py` prints %/h per arm with error bars (battery is 1 %-granular;
+arms under 20 min are flagged low-trust). Conclusions (validated / rejected /
+inconclusive) go on FRO-393.
+
+## 3. FRO-394 — resilience drills (~1 h, indoors + one soak)
+
+The full matrix with pass criteria lives on the **DRILLS** screen in the app
+(footer button). Summary: lock 30 min → force-quit/relaunch → ballast-jetsam
+→ airplane-mode toggle → phone call → 4 h locked soak (walk/turbo). Every
+drill runs with a run active; the CSVs are the evidence (`fix`-row gaps,
+`recovered_relaunch` lineage, `cl_diag` flags, `scene=` brackets). Note the
+jetsam wake latency (gap between the killed CSV's last row and the new CSV's
+first) on FRO-394.
+
+## 4. S2 leftovers (same phone session, ~25 min)
+
+- LAB screen protocol: Q1 locked-phone heartbeat (location OFF), Q2 Live
+  Activity delivery, crash → recover → Apple Health round trip.
+- Fill the empirical blanks in `docs/dts-drafts.md` from the lab log, then
+  file the two DTS tickets from the developer account.
+
+## Honesty notes
+
+- The harness dashboard was restyled on 2026-08-15 (`ui=soft-instrument-v1`
+  in CSV headers); don't compare %/h across different `ui` tags — the
+  lit-pixel budget changed.
+- `drills=v1` headers mark runs with per-fix journal rows; the extra I/O is
+  negligible (<0.01% duty cycle) but the tag keeps it auditable.

# Field protocol — the 0.1.0 device sessions

Everything the remaining 0.1.0 validation needs from a physical iPhone, in
one place: FRO-392 (go/no-go battery report), FRO-393 (A/B experiments),
FRO-394 (resilience drills), plus the S2 leftovers. Total: one indoor hour
plus 3+ rides.

## 0. Install (once per phone)

1. Open `Rouleur.xcodeproj` in Xcode, select the **RouleurHarness** scheme,
   destination = your iPhone, Run. (Signing team is configured; first run on
   a new phone needs Settings → General → VPN & Device Management → trust.)
2. Launch the harness, tap START once — grant **When-In-Use** location when
   prompted — then STOP. The app is ready.
3. Optional (S2 lab): tap LAB → "Request HealthKit authorization" → grant
   all. Needed only for the workout-session drills.

Data comes back via the **LOG** button (share sheet → AirDrop) — one CSV per
run. Analyze on the Mac with:

```sh
python3 scripts/analyze-s1.py harness-*.csv
```

## 1. FRO-392 — battery/accuracy report rides (the go/no-go)

**Protocol** (per the ticket):

- ≥3 rides of 1–2 h, at least one in direct midday sun, phone bar-mounted,
  max auto-brightness, screen on the whole ride (START and leave it).
- Reference head unit (Garmin/Wahoo) recording side-by-side for
  distance/speed/elevation comparison.
- Two device generations if possible (13-class + 15/16-class).
- Note ambient temp and any visible dimming; the CSV captures thermal state,
  brightness, and battery timeline.

**Thresholds**: pass ≤8 %/h screen-on · stretch ≤6 · kill/pivot >12.
Distance ±2% vs reference; speed stable ±1 km/h at cruise; elevation ±10%.

**Output**: per-ride table from `analyze-s1.py` + subjective sunlight-
readability note → written report on FRO-392 with a go/no-go recommendation.

## 2. FRO-393 — A/B arms (same route, ≥1 h per arm)

Controls: fix brightness manually (note the value — it's logged), airplane
mode ON for both arms, same route/day where possible. Toggle **exactly one**
variable per segment — each toggle writes an event row the analyzer segments
on, so a single long ride can carry multiple arms.

1. **BLK vs WHT** at outdoor brightness — validates the OLED display-power
   claim.
2. **10 Hz vs 60 Hz** — the low-refresh win.
3. **LIVE vs MGR** (liveUpdates vs legacy manager) — energy cost of the
   modern path; no public measurement exists.

`analyze-s1.py` prints %/h per arm with error bars (battery is 1 %-granular;
arms under 20 min are flagged low-trust). Conclusions (validated / rejected /
inconclusive) go on FRO-393.

## 3. FRO-394 — resilience drills (~1 h, indoors + one soak)

The full matrix with pass criteria lives on the **DRILLS** screen in the app
(footer button). Summary: lock 30 min → force-quit/relaunch → ballast-jetsam
→ airplane-mode toggle → phone call → 4 h locked soak (walk/turbo). Every
drill runs with a run active; the CSVs are the evidence (`fix`-row gaps,
`recovered_relaunch` lineage, `cl_diag` flags, `scene=` brackets). Note the
jetsam wake latency (gap between the killed CSV's last row and the new CSV's
first) on FRO-394.

## 4. S2 leftovers (same phone session, ~25 min)

- LAB screen protocol: Q1 locked-phone heartbeat (location OFF), Q2 Live
  Activity delivery, crash → recover → Apple Health round trip.
- Fill the empirical blanks in `docs/dts-drafts.md` from the lab log, then
  file the two DTS tickets from the developer account.

## Honesty notes

- The harness dashboard was restyled on 2026-08-15 (`ui=soft-instrument-v1`
  in CSV headers); don't compare %/h across different `ui` tags — the
  lit-pixel budget changed.
- `drills=v1` headers mark runs with per-fix journal rows; the extra I/O is
  negligible (<0.01% duty cycle) but the tag keeps it auditable.

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""FRO-393 analyzer: harness CSVs -> %/h per experiment arm.
+
+Usage: analyze-s1.py run1.csv [run2.csv ...]
+
+Segments each run at mid-run toggle events (theme= / refresh= / backend=),
+computes battery drain per segment, and prints a result table grouped by arm
+(theme x refresh x backend x ui tag) with honest error bars: battery_pct has
+1% granularity, so a segment's uncertainty is +/-(1% / duration_h).
+
+Python 3 stdlib only.
+"""
+
+import sys
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+
+TOGGLE_KEYS = ("theme", "refresh", "backend")
+MIN_TRUSTED_MINUTES = 20
+GAP_WARN_SECONDS = 10
+
+
+def parse_ts(value):
+    return datetime.strptime(value, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ").replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Segment:
+    arm: dict
+    start: datetime
+    rows: list = field(default_factory=list)
+
+    def finish(self, end):
+        self.end = end
+
+    @property
+    def duration_h(self):
+        return (self.end - self.start).total_seconds() / 3600
+
+    def battery_series(self):
+        return [
+            (parse_ts(r["timestamp"]), float(r["battery_pct"]))
+            for r in self.rows
+            if r["battery_pct"] not in ("", None)
+        ]
+
+    def location_rows(self):
+        return [r for r in self.rows if r["lat"] not in ("", None)]
+
+
+def parse_file(path):
+    """Returns (metadata, segments, warnings)."""
+    metadata, segments, warnings = {}, [], []
+    header_fields = None
+    current = None
+
+    with open(path) as fh:
+        for line in fh:
+            line = line.rstrip("\n")
+            if line.startswith("# "):
+                key, _, value = line[2:].partition("=")
+                metadata[key] = value
+                continue
+            if header_fields is None:
+                header_fields = line.split(",")
+                continue
+            values = line.split(",")
+            if len(values) != len(header_fields):
+                warnings.append(f"{path}: malformed row skipped: {line[:60]}")
+                continue
+            row = dict(zip(header_fields, values))
+            ts = parse_ts(row["timestamp"])
+
+            if current is None:
+                arm = {k: metadata.get(k, "?") for k in TOGGLE_KEYS}
+                arm["ui"] = metadata.get("ui", "?")
+                current = Segment(arm=arm, start=ts)
+
+            event = row.get("event", "")
+            toggle = next(
+                (k for k in TOGGLE_KEYS if event.startswith(f"{k}=")), None
+            )
+            if toggle:
+                current.finish(ts)
+                segments.append(current)
+                arm = dict(current.arm)
+                arm[toggle] = event.split("=", 1)[1]
+                current = Segment(arm=arm, start=ts)
+            current.rows.append(row)
+
+    if current is not None and current.rows:
+        current.finish(parse_ts(current.rows[-1]["timestamp"]))
+        segments.append(current)
+    return metadata, segments, warnings
+
+
+def analyze_segment(seg, path, warnings):
+    battery = seg.battery_series()
+    result = {
+        "arm": seg.arm,
+        "duration_h": seg.duration_h,
+        "file": path,
+        "trusted": seg.duration_h * 60 >= MIN_TRUSTED_MINUTES,
+    }
+
+    result["drain_per_h"] = None  # simulator or too little data
+    if len(battery) >= 2:
+        span_h = (battery[-1][0] - battery[0][0]).total_seconds() / 3600
+        if span_h > 0:
+            result["drain_per_h"] = (battery[0][1] - battery[-1][1]) / span_h
+            result["error_bar"] = 1.0 / span_h  # 1% granularity
+
+    locs = seg.location_rows()
+    if locs:
+        accs = [float(r["h_acc_m"]) for r in locs if r["h_acc_m"]]
+        result["mean_acc"] = sum(accs) / len(accs) if accs else None
+        result["fixes"] = len(locs)
+        prev = None
+        max_gap = 0.0
+        for r in locs:
+            ts = parse_ts(r["timestamp"])
+            if prev is not None:
+                max_gap = max(max_gap, (ts - prev).total_seconds())
+            prev = ts
+        result["max_gap_s"] = max_gap
+        if max_gap > GAP_WARN_SECONDS:
+            warnings.append(
+                f"{path}: location gap of {max_gap:.0f}s in arm "
+                f"{arm_label(seg.arm)} — possible silent stop (FRO-394)"
+            )
+    thermals = {r["thermal"] for r in seg.rows if r["thermal"]}
+    result["thermals"] = ",".join(sorted(thermals)) or "-"
+    return result
+
+
+def arm_label(arm):
+    return f"{arm['theme']}/{arm['refresh']}/{arm['backend']}/{arm['ui']}"
+
+
+def main(paths):
+    if not paths:
+        sys.exit(__doc__)
+
+    all_results, warnings = [], []
+    for path in paths:
+        _, segments, file_warnings = parse_file(path)
+        warnings.extend(file_warnings)
+        for seg in segments:
+            all_results.append(analyze_segment(seg, path, warnings))
+
+    # Aggregate by arm, duration-weighted.
+    by_arm = {}
+    for r in all_results:
+        by_arm.setdefault(arm_label(r["arm"]), []).append(r)
+
+    print(f"{'arm (theme/refresh/backend/ui)':40} {'time':>7} {'%/h':>12} {'acc m':>6} {'gap s':>6} {'thermal':>10}")
+    print("-" * 88)
+    for label, results in sorted(by_arm.items()):
+        hours = sum(r["duration_h"] for r in results)
+        drains = [(r["drain_per_h"], r["duration_h"]) for r in results if r["drain_per_h"] is not None]
+        if drains:
+            weighted = sum(d * h for d, h in drains) / sum(h for _, h in drains)
+            err = 1.0 / sum(h for _, h in drains)
+            drain_txt = f"{weighted:+.1f} ±{err:.1f}"
+        else:
+            drain_txt = "n/a (no batt)"
+        accs = [r["mean_acc"] for r in results if r.get("mean_acc")]
+        acc_txt = f"{sum(accs)/len(accs):.0f}" if accs else "-"
+        gaps = [r.get("max_gap_s", 0) for r in results]
+        thermals = ",".join(sorted({t for r in results for t in r["thermals"].split(",")}))
+        flag = "" if all(r["trusted"] for r in results) else "  (short segments — <20 min, low trust)"
+        print(f"{label:40} {hours*60:5.0f}m {drain_txt:>12} {acc_txt:>6} {max(gaps):6.0f} {thermals:>10}{flag}")
+
+    if not any(r["drain_per_h"] is not None for r in all_results):
+        print("\nNo battery data in any file — simulator CSVs report no battery level;")
+        print("run the arms on a physical device for %/h numbers.")
+
+    if warnings:
+        print("\nWarnings:")
+        for w in warnings:
+            print(f"  - {w}")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main(sys.argv[1:])

expectedFindings.label: GPS gap detection iterates sample rows that repeat the last fix instead of the new fix rows: real stalls masked, false warnings
